description: This file is a shell script that contains tests for checkout handling of ambiguous references (branches vs tags) in a Git project. It sets up test cases, executes Git commands, and verifies expected outputs and behaviors related to ambiguous refs.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a new commit with specified files for testing purposes.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a given description.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Checks if a pattern exists in a given file output.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or outputs to verify they are identical.

methods.name: test_set_prereq
methods.description: Sets prerequisites or expectations for subsequent tests.
